_comment: Job queue for the autonomous Colab GPU worker (scripts/colab_worker.py). Claude edits this to request experiments; the worker runs any job whose results/auto/<id>/summary.csv does not yet exist, then commits + pushes results. Keep jobs small enough to finish within a Colab session.

jobs.note: Fail-fast: does FedGMA run end-to-end on GPU? Tiny grid; if this errors, its summary.csv row carries the traceback for Claude to fix.

FedGMA vs all baselines, 4 datasets x 5 seeds. Front-loaded batch: the free worker runs all of this before Claude needs to engage (usage-budget friendly). Fills the RESEARCH_LOG leaderboard with statistical power.
